I don't think the new pricing page is working. Bounce rate's up almost 9% since we shipped it, which is a lot for a change this small.

My best guess is the comparison table. It's dense and I think people are just leaving before they finish reading it. We could try collapsing the least-used plan by default and see if that helps. Worth an A/B test before we commit to a full redesign though, I've been wrong about this kind of thing before.
